tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Brand green. Fills, accent rules, the 3px focus outline, the form-card top bar and the active carousel hover. Never use as text on `surface` (2.4:1); pair it only with `ink` text (6.4:1).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Lime end of the brand gradient (`linear-gradient(90deg, lime, green)`). Primary-button hover, cookie accept button, form-card top bar. Text on it is `ink` (9.4:1).

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: Dark green for the hover state of the lime-gradient button. White text on it is 5.6:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `surface`, `panel` and `green`/`lime` fills (15.3:1 on `surface`). Fill of the dark pill buttons, carousel arrows, active dot and cookie bar.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface` (6.1:1) and `panel` (5.8:1): dates, form labels, success copy.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, form-card border and header bottom border on `surface`. Decorative only; never the sole cue for a control.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and card fill. Ground for all `ink` and `ink-muted` text.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Form fields, unselected pills and the legal callout. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Resting border of text fields and pills on `panel`.

tokens.name: field-border-hover
tokens.usage: Hover border of text fields and pills.

tokens.name: field-label
tokens.usage: Uppercase group titles in the form card on `surface`. 3.1:1 at 12px, below the 4.5:1 text floor; kept exact from the live site, use `ink-muted` for any new label.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text inside fields on `panel` (2.4:1). Kept exact from the live site; never carry required information in a placeholder.

tokens.name: footer
tokens.usage: Footer background: a muted violet-grey, the only dark colored surface. White text on it is 6.6:1.

tokens.name: footer-text
tokens.usage: Legal copy and links on `footer` (78% white, 4.8:1).

tokens.name: footer-icon
tokens.usage: Social icons on `footer`. 2.6:1 against `footer`, below the 3:1 floor for meaningful icons; kept exact, hovers to white.

tokens.name: notice-bg
tokens.usage: Pale amber ground of the consent notice and the placeholder-state pill.

tokens.name: notice-border
tokens.usage: Dashed 2px border of the consent notice (2.2:1 on `surface`, decorative; the box also carries text).

tokens.name: notice-text
tokens.usage: Text on `notice-bg` (6.9:1).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the white cookie button.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Inactive carousel dot on `surface`. Decorative; the active dot is `ink`.

tokens.name: dot-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of an inactive carousel dot.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Soft blue used only inside photography overlays (the right peak in the two-peak images) and map pins. Sampled from the imagery, not used in UI.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, Logout pill, and the footer ground and curve on signed-in and form pages. White text on it is 5.3:1. The marketing footer token `footer` (#5f5a6b) is a darker sibling; keep each page family consistent.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Decorative glyphs: the large user icon next to page titles and the dots and pins of the world map. 3.4:1 on `surface`, so never use it for text.

tokens.name: green-ui
tokens.usage: Interface green: links, field icons, the phone prefix, required asterisks and the Save button. 2.0:1 on `surface` (below the 4.5:1 text floor); the exported mockups use it for text anyway, so pair link text with an underline. `ink` text on it is 7.7:1.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Quick-action tiles on signed-in pages. `ink` text on it is 11.5:1.

tokens.name: card-grey
tokens.usage: Profile summary card on signed-in pages. `ink` text on it is 11.8:1.
